Single i.p. doses up to 36 mg/kg (limit of solubility) caused no weight loss or signs of distress over 6 days (Fig. S8 in SI); a toxic dose was not reached. Group size and sex not given in the main text. Read from the SI received 2026-11-16 (Fig. S8): two mice per treatment. After the single 36 mg/kg dose one mouse given 1 falls to about 98 % of its starting weight on day 3 and recovers, the other only gains, so the maximum loss is 2 %.
